name: gideonai-discord-desk
description: Discord Desk pairs a Discord bot with Gideon for DM and server conversations. Converse in tracked channels, receive results with approval buttons, and fire automations from inbound messages.
author: Gideon

x-meta.label: Bot Token
x-meta.help: Discord bot token from the Developer Portal (Bot → Reset Token). Sent as 'Authorization: Bot <token>'.

x-meta.label: Application ID
x-meta.help: The Discord application's ID (Developer Portal → General Information). Public, not a secret — used for the bot invite URL.

x-meta.label: DM Activation
x-meta.help: Default activation mode for direct messages.
